summary: Comprehensive multi-level test suite covering core logic, CLI interface, workflow structure, and end-to-end pipeline execution through act. All major requirements exercised: glob matching, priority resolution, label deduplication, error handling, and config/file parsing. Strong fixture design (4 integration cases) with clear expected outputs. Edge cases well-tested but could expand glob pattern variations (currently tests *, **, but not ?, {a,b} patterns). Minor gaps: filesystem edge cases (very long paths, special chars) not directly tested, main() error handling only exercised through integration tests. Would reliably catch regressions for common scenarios; workflow structure validation via actionlint ensures CI compatibility.
